_comment: Hoodrich product catalogue. Edit freely - the mod reloads this on startup.
id        stable key used in save files; never change it once you have a save
name      full name shown in notifications
tag       short label drawn on the wheel (keep it to 4 characters)
basePrice street price per gram before night/rank/heat modifiers
tier      1 = low risk street weight, 3 = brings heat. Gates resupply by rank.
heatFactor how much attention one sale attracts, relative to 1.0
Prices are per GRAM and are meant to sit where the real ones do, so a gram and an
eighth both come out at numbers that look right: weed at 20 a gram is 50 for an
eighth once the bulk discount is applied, coke at 200 is about 450. Buying weight
off a supplier costs a fraction of these -- that spread is the whole business.
